contexts.text: Many of the infernals are pre-eminently skilled in doctrinal things.
Their tails = the more crafty reasonings... against truths; the more crafty the reasonings are, the lower they are.
Those infernals are set over the others who excel in craftiness and arts...
They who are skilled in the art of letting good Spirits into their proprium.
The sensuous... are pre-eminently crafty and cunning... and their craftiness and cunning they call intelligence and wisdom.
As sensuous men are crafty and cunning, like foxes, the Lord says, Be ye prudent as serpents.
